{{Top|leg}}
A '''weapons facility''' was constructed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taspan II]]. [[Gravity well/Legends|Gravity well]] projectors were tested by Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] in the factory around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. However, the facility was abandoned and the planet destroyed during the cataclysmic [[Big Crush]].
